structure: A Playwright trace corpus of the INS frontend's fit specs, recorded at trade-imports-ins-frontend 406e300: 50 folders under workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/traces-ins-fit/, each holding one trace.zip, plus report.json (the Playwright JSON report, with an npm/webpack preamble before the JSON) that maps every test to its folder. All 50 tests passed. They come from 7 spec files: fit/smoke.fit.spec.js (1 test: sign in, dashboard, add, view and delete an address), and under src/server/app/features/: address-book/fit/add.fit.spec.js (21 tests: the add form, 7 empty-field errors, 8 over-length errors, a malformed email, two axe checks, save and cancel), address-book/fit/list.fit.spec.js (6: navigation, the table, add link, axe, pagination over 25, empty state), address-book/fit/view.fit.spec.js (5: open, every Standard Address Block field, Edit and Delete, Back, axe), address-book/fit/edit.fit.spec.js (7: prefill, axe, rejected save keeps edits, malformed email, error-state axe, save, cancel) and address-book/fit/delete.fit.spec.js (4: confirmation, cancel, confirm, axe), and dashboard/dashboard.fit.spec.js (6: statuses and columns, axe, submitted links to notification-view, draft links to the journey hub, search by reference, no results). It covers the INS front door only: the address book (list, view, add, edit, delete) and the notifications dashboard, as the real INS frontend renders them today. It leaves out the animals journey, which trace:animals-fit holds. The corpus is indexed from report.json in trace-ins-fit.work/index.md. The traces were written by Playwright 1.63.0 and tim's bundled Playwright (1.62.1) cannot open them (TraceVersionError), so action and error counts are not indexed, and each part also names its spec file so the agent can read the steps and asserted copy until tim's Playwright is upgraded.
